about: Issue #709, ADR-110: the standard units every shop gets, in the order the pickers show them, the packages of a fixed count, and the package words: a unit named by one is a package, never a new item's single unit. The server reads this very file (StandardUnits, RetailCatalogue.PACKAGE_WORDS) and the PWA imports it (the Units page, the retail mock). Roll is a standard package that may also be a single unit (tape, tissue and wire are sold by the roll), so it is not a package word.
